title: Material Detectives · Q4 W07 D03
objective: Describe familiar materials by observable properties and choose safe uses or handling.
introduction: Milo stirs with a wooden spoon — it is hard! And bubble wrap goes pop-pop-pop. What properties can you find?

items.explanation: Rubber band bends easily, so it is flexible.
Cotton cloth soaks up water, so it absorbs water.
Stone is firm and does not bend, so it is hard.

items.prompt: What property does a glass cup have?
items.explanation: A glass cup lets light pass through, so it is see-through.

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to learn about a material?

options.text: look at it and touch it gently

items.explanation: Looking at it and touching it gently is safe. Tasting, throwing, or hitting materials is not safe.
